about: check-size.mts --budgets: gzip bytes the browser downloads, per class, from dist/ after npm run build. A size over its budget fails; a size more than 5% under fails until the budget is lowered, so budgets only go down. Set 2026-11-04 from the fork's main at about 1% over the measured size. 2026-11-05: lazy raised from 3055000 to 3055261 (measured 3055251 at 2f33440): #208 added 229 B of lazy JS (call sites for the deferred heli load; boot and entry did not change) and later PRs the rest. 2026-11-06: lazy raised from 3055261 to 3055314 (measured 3055304 at #207's merge with d9f4def): the ?ktx2=etc1s mode adds about 35 B to the ktx2-tex chunk, and the chunk's new content hash changes the import paths embedded in about 200 other lazy chunks by 1-3 B each.
